Senses.Explanation: Literally (麻) (hemp) + (三斤) (three catties, a weight): 'three catties of hemp.' It is Dongshan Shouchu's (洞山守初, 910–990) answer to the stock question (如何是佛) 'what is Buddha' — (五燈會元), under the head (襄州洞山守初宗慧禪師): (問)。(如何是佛)。(師曰)。(麻三斤). The question-and-answer form recurs across the record (如何是佛 answered by 麻三斤: 31× in 25 allowlist files; 麻三斤 in all positions: 490× in 174 files), and the Blue Cliff Record's own commentary lists it among the (答佛話), the recorded answers to the Buddha-question: (古人有多少答佛話)。(或云)。(殿裏底)。(或云)。(三十二相)。(或云)。(杖林山下竹筋鞭)。(及至洞山)。(却道麻三斤) (T48n2003). The record pairs it with Yunmen's (乾屎橛) ('dried shit-stick') — B25n0145: (惟雲門乾屎橛)。(洞山麻三斤)。(却較些子) — and the same text groups it with the cases it describes as (略無義路): (如庭前栢樹子麻三斤乾屎橛之類)。(略無義路與人穿鑿) ('the likes of the cypress in the courtyard, three catties of hemp, the dry shit-stick — with hardly any reasoning-path for people to bore into'). It circulates as a fixed case: Wumenguan Case 18 (洞山三斤, verse 突出麻三斤), Blue Cliff Record Case 12, and countless (拈古)/(頌古) verses; masters and monks probe it as an established saying under examination (X80n1565: 洞山麻三斤。意旨如何 — the probe form 麻三斤 + 意旨如何 appears in 11 allowlist files), and the probes draw their own recorded answers: (說破不值錢) (J29nB244, the master posing it to a monk; the same answer master-to-master in J40nB483), (秤頭八兩)，(秤尾半斤) (J33nB280), (八十婆婆不粧梳) (X78n1553), (智門)'s (花簇簇錦簇簇) (raised in T48n2003). The Blue Cliff Record also records the readings circulating in its day — (人多作話會道)。(洞山是時在庫下)。(秤麻) (he was weighing hemp in the storehouse when asked); (有底道)。(洞山問東答西); (有底道)。(爾是佛)。(更去問佛)。(所以洞山遶路答之) — and of the reading (只這麻三斤便是佛) it says (且得沒交涉) ('no connection whatsoever'). The texts record the answer and the probes on it without assigning the phrase a gloss, and neither does this entry.
Senses.Note: Attribution trap: in later citations plain (洞山) here = Dongshan Shouchu (守初) (910–990), the Yunmen-line master who gave this answer, NOT the Caodong founder Dongshan Liangjie (良价) (807–869). The texts disambiguate him as (洞山初) / (洞山初和尚) / (襄州洞山守初宗慧禪師). Orthographic variant: (麻三觔) (觔 = 斤) is the same word and appears 107× in 46 allowlist files; it will not substring-match this head term (麻三斤). Collocations (allowlist, grep-verified): (洞山麻三斤) 76× in 54 files; the idiom (貼秤麻)(三斤) 12× in 10 files (e.g. C077n1710: 賤賣擔板漢貼秤麻三斤). All occurrences except the (五燈會元) biographical one are raised/quoted cases (舉…, 因僧問…, or list-of-answers), so their MasterName is null per the governing section head; only the (五燈會元) head (襄州洞山守初宗慧禪師) attributes the answer to Dongshan Shouchu himself.

Occurrences.Kwic: 問。如何是佛。師曰。麻三斤。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The origin. Sits in Dongshan Shouchu's own biography in (五燈會元) (governing head 襄州洞山守初宗慧禪師); (師) = Dongshan Shouchu answering.

Occurrences.Kwic: 僧問洞山。如何是佛。洞山云。麻三斤。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Earliest transmission-record witness (景德傳燈錄, ~1004). Raised inside the entry of (雙泉師寬) (Shuangquan Shikuan, 隋州雙泉山師寬明教大師, a 法嗣 of Yunmen), who comments on it (師聞之乃曰…); a quoted case (僧問洞山), so MasterName null.

Occurrences.Kwic: 突出麻三斤言親意更親
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Wumen Huikai's capping verse to Wumenguan Case 18 (洞山三斤). A raised case + verse comment; MasterName null.
Yuanwu Keqin's pointer in Blue Cliff Record Case 12, listing (麻三斤) among the stock answers to 'what is Buddha' (殿裏底 / 三十二相 / 杖林山下竹筋鞭 …). Raised case.

Occurrences.Kwic: 惟雲門乾屎橛。洞山麻三斤。却較些子。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Singles out (惟…却較些子) Yunmen's (乾屎橛) and Dongshan's (麻三斤) together; elsewhere the same text groups them among cases (略無義路與人穿鑿) (hardly any reasoning-path to bore into). General discussion listing cases; MasterName null.
A monk (under the head 自巖上座) probes the meaning of the established saying — evidence that (麻三斤) had become a fixed case people question.
